WITH rep_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    e.EmployeeId,
    e.City,
    COUNT(c.CustomerId) as customer_count
  FROM Employee e
  LEFT JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId
  WHERE c.CustomerId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City
),
city_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    City,
    AVG(customer_count) as avg_count
  FROM rep_counts
  GROUP BY City
),
filtered_reps AS (
  SELECT 
    rc.EmployeeId,
    rc.City,
    rc.customer_count,
    ca.avg_count
  FROM rep_counts rc
  JOIN city_averages ca ON (rc.City = ca.City OR (rc.City IS NULL AND ca.City IS NULL))
  WHERE rc.customer_count > ca.avg_count
),
overall_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(customer_count) as total FROM rep_counts
)
SELECT 
  fr.City,
  SUM(fr.customer_count) as total_customers,
  AVG(fr.customer_count - fr.avg_count) as avg_above_city_average,
  AVG(fr.customer_count / ot.total) as avg_rep_share
FROM filtered_reps fr
CROSS JOIN overall_total ot
GROUP BY fr.City
ORDER BY fr.City
